plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Associate of Arts' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid, hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The generic Associate of Arts transfer degree (no emphasis); satisfactory completion guarantees fulfillment of lower-division general education requirements at UNR, UNLV, or NSU. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 2 = approved General Education list for the AA, 3 = foreign language requirement options (fourth-semester transferable college course, ASL, or demonstrated proficiency), 4 = any approved university transfer course (elective units) — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
